notes: Town visits are now saved: if you close the game in town, Continue brings you back to the shop with your gold and items intact.
You now arrive in town by the fountain, well away from the exit portal.
The town shop no longer shows a "leaves in 9997s" timer, and pop-up messages no longer hide behind the stage banner.
Armory buttons are bigger and easier to tap. On phones the three talent trees now have tabs, so you see one tree at a time.
The "show my gear" option now works with the pixel-art heroes.
Class screen on phones: the shard counter fits on one line, and tapping the locked map tells you how to unlock it.
Summoner minions hit a bit harder (familiars, archers, hounds, imps and the colossus).
